title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-i1gk.102: lichen_link_tx() writes *out_len before tx_queue_push can fail
description:
In lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c:160, *out_len = off is written BEFORE the tx_queue_push() call at line 177-183. If tx_queue_push() fails (returns < 0), the function goes to cleanup and returns an error, but *out_len has already been written with the (now-unreliable) frame length.

Currently this is not a runtime bug because the caller (lichen_l2_send_inner) checks ret < 0 before using frame_len. But it violates output-parameter conventions and is a time bomb if:
- The caller's error-check ordering changes
- Someone reads *out_len on the error path in the caller

Fix: Move *out_len = off to after tx_queue_push succeeds, or add *out_len = 0 on the tx_queue_push error path before goto cleanup.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c
